title: Sollis et al. 2023 NAR: The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog knowledgebase and deposition resources
summary: Nucleic Acids Research database article describing the GWAS Catalog as a FAIR knowledgebase, its scale, data acquisition, summary-statistics deposition, and diversity/data-sharing limits.

source_payload.copyability: not embedded; exact URL, retrieval time, web reference ids, and line/page locators recorded; local archival/hash pass deferred
line_locators_used: L1021-L1025: abstract describes FAIR knowledgebase, >200,000 users/year, >45,000 published GWAS across >5,000 human traits, and >40,000 full P-value summary-statistics datasets
L1029-L1034: largest/complete public FAIR GWAS resource, GUI/download/API access, curated publications and structured metadata
L1043-L1045: summary statistics provide more detailed information than lead associations and availability has increased
L1064-L1068: standard format, CC0 terms for submissions since March 2021, persistent study accessions and release paths
L1103-L1109: 77% of publications did not share summary statistics freely at time of publication and diversity concerns are explicitly discussed
extraction_notes: One-pass source extraction for rev0018 candidate-gene / GWAS denominator lane.
Used only for bounded source-backed claims listed in records and claim ledger; not a full source edition.
Psychiatric/behavioral genetics claims must preserve scope, population, ancestry, phenotype, and statistical-threshold cautions.

handling_notes: Do not use source as a people-shaming surface; encode claims, methods, denominators, and uncertainty.
Do not turn negative candidate-gene records into anti-genetics claims or clinical advice.
No individual-level genetic or participant data is imported.
